selection_policy_zh: 只安装最近一周仍活跃、仓库星标/可信来源较强、包含真实 SKILL.md、和现有库互补、且能通过 portal API 与元数据审计闭环的子 skill；聚合目录、强外部引擎依赖、敏感安全/攻击场景或明显重叠能力进入观察雷达。
selection_policy_en: Install only recently active, reputable repositories with real SKILL.md files, complementary coverage, and a clean portal/API plus metadata audit path; keep aggregators, external-engine-dependent tools, sensitive security/offensive packs, and overlapping capabilities on the watchlist.

groups.why_zh: 补齐最近 30 天多源用户声音与趋势研究，可直接服务 idea 验证、竞品观察和内容选题。
groups.why_en: Adds last-30-days multi-source voice-of-customer and trend research for idea validation, competitor monitoring, and content planning.

groups.why_zh: 补齐长任务文件化计划、发现记录与进度恢复能力，降低上下文压缩或 /clear 后的交接损耗。
groups.why_en: Adds file-backed task planning, findings, and progress recovery for long-running agent work across context loss or /clear.

groups.why_zh: 补齐 Markdown 到微信公众号 HTML、预览、草稿与图文分发能力，覆盖中文内容增长链路。
groups.why_en: Adds Markdown-to-WeChat HTML, preview, draft, and image-post distribution for Chinese content growth workflows.

groups.why_zh: 补齐 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、hooks、MCP 等 agent 配置 lint 能力，适合本项目后续治理。
groups.why_en: Adds linting for AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, hooks, MCP, and related agent configuration files.

groups.why_zh: 补齐网站、截图、Figma 与视觉参考的设计系统提取能力，可服务网站优化和竞品设计复盘。
groups.why_en: Adds design-system extraction from websites, screenshots, Figma, and visual references for website optimization and design reviews.

radar.decision_zh: 官方基础包仍是高优先观察源；当前本地库已覆盖部分基础能力，后续按缺口选择性补装。
radar.decision_en: Official base pack remains a high-priority source; the local library already covers part of it, so install selectively by gap.

radar.decision_zh: 1500+ installable skills 大型聚合库，适合发现趋势；必须按主题 dry-scan 后分批纳入。
radar.decision_en: A 1500+ installable-skill library for discovery; requires topic-based dry-scan before batch adoption.

radar.decision_zh: 科学研究垂直领域包，价值高但超出当前通用工作流主线；后续按科研/医药/数据任务补齐。
radar.decision_en: High-value scientific domain pack, but outside the current general workflow lane; install later by research, biomedical, or data need.

radar.decision_zh: 含 Google Workspace agent skills，适合 Drive/Gmail/Sheets/Docs 自动化；需先验证本地 CLI 与账号授权边界。
radar.decision_en: Includes Google Workspace agent skills for Drive, Gmail, Sheets, and Docs automation; validate local CLI and auth boundaries first.

radar.decision_zh: SkillOpt-Sleep 与本项目自优化方向匹配，但依赖完整外部引擎路径，先作为实验项保留。
radar.decision_en: SkillOpt-Sleep aligns with self-optimization, but depends on the full external engine path, so keep it as an experiment.

radar.decision_zh: 安全攻防 skill 集合价值高但场景敏感，需先拆分防守/审计子集并建立使用边界。
radar.decision_en: Security/offensive skill pack with value but sensitive scope; split defensive/audit subsets and define guardrails first.

radar.decision_zh: 跨平台 skill factory 能力活跃，但和本地 skill-creator/write-a-skill 重叠，后续做差异评估。
radar.decision_en: Active cross-platform skill factory, but overlaps with local skill-creator/write-a-skill; evaluate the delta later.

radar.decision_zh: Codex/Claude/Cursor/OpenClaw 兼容技能与 AGENTS.md playbooks 集合，可作为后续批量筛选源。
radar.decision_en: Curated Codex/Claude/Cursor/OpenClaw-compatible skills and AGENTS.md playbooks; keep as a future batch-curation source.
